name: Hazevale
description: A quiet mountain village that keeps to itself, wrapped in a fog that never quite lifts.

valley_path.name: Valley Path
valley_path.description: A path winds down into the village between wet stones.

village_square.name: Village Square
village_square.description: A small square with a well. Fog lies in the streets like milk.

inn.name: The Fogwatch Inn
inn.description: A low common room with a banked fire, a long table scarred by knives, and a window that looks out on nothing but fog.

ruined_lane.name: Lane of Cottages
ruined_lane.description: A lane of low cottages. The doors are shut.

shrine.name: Village Shrine
shrine.description: A stone shrine with a ring of small offerings around its base. A lamp burns low in front of it, and the stone is warm as if someone has only just left.
